buildCommand: if [ -f package.json ]; then npm run build && rm -rf dist-root && mkdir -p dist-root && cp -R dist/. dist-root/; elif [ -f admin/package.json ]; then cd admin && npm run build && rm -rf ../dist-root && mkdir -p ../dist-root && cp -R dist/. ../dist-root/; elif [ -f frontend/admin/package.json ]; then cd frontend/admin && npm run build && rm -rf ../../dist-root && mkdir -p ../../dist-root && cp -R dist/. ../../dist-root/; else echo 'No frontend package.json found for build' && exit 1; fi
installCommand: if [ -f package.json ]; then npm install; elif [ -f admin/package.json ]; then cd admin && npm install; elif [ -f frontend/admin/package.json ]; then cd frontend/admin && npm install; else echo 'No frontend package.json found for install' && exit 1; fi
